title: Weekend Box Office 13-15 Nov 2026: Ramayana: Part 1 made Rs 196 cr India net in its second weekend (Sacnilk), India's biggest second weekend per Sacnilk (past Pushpa 2 Rs 176.30 cr, Dhurandhar 2 Rs 172.70 cr) and above its own first weekend (Rs 174 cr); Rs 760.60 cr India net and Rs 1,384.50 cr worldwide gross in 11 days (Sacnilk); Bollywood Hungama's lower count Rs 184.41 cr weekend, Rs 724.04 cr total. Suriya's Scene: Rs 24.8 cr second weekend, Rs 136.5 cr India net in 10 days (Sacnilk, Koimoi), over Rs 240 cr worldwide, Suriya's second-biggest after Karuppu. Fri 20 Nov: Ramayana's two-week India IMAX exclusivity ends and Godzilla Minus Zero opens in India incl. IMAX (Sacnilk, Bollywood Hungama).
headline: Ramayana's ₹196 Crore Is India's Biggest Second Weekend, Sacnilk Says
